title: RNAlater Recipe
author: Rex Malmstrom
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ifhubn

steps.title: Prepare Base Solution
steps.instruction: Mix the water, EDTA, and sodium citrate in a flask with stirring.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1,400 mL MilliQ water, 60 mL 0.5M EDTA, and 37.5 mL 1M sodium citrate.

steps.title: Add Ammonium Sulfate
steps.instruction: Add ammonium sulfate (Catalog #97061-184) to the stirring solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.05 kg (1,050 g) of ammonium sulfate in 100 g increments.

steps.title: Dissolve Ammonium Sulfate
steps.instruction: Stir the mixture on a hot plate set to low for approximately 30 minutes until crystals dissolve.

steps.title: Cool Solution
steps.instruction: Allow the solution to cool at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Cool for at least 30 minutes, though overnight on the bench is preferred.

steps.title: Filter Solution
steps.instruction: Filter the solution through a 0.2 μm filter to remove any remaining particles.

steps.title: Store Solution
steps.instruction: Store the final solution at room temperature or at 4°C.
